errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, beginning with the largest slice and proceeding to the smallest.
errors.evidence: This claim about the ordering is incorrect. Starting from the largest slice (Level 2, 44.32%), the next slice clockwise is Level 3 (25.64%), followed by Level 1 (30.04%). This sequence is not ordered from largest to smallest.
